{"id":1796650071,"question_id":99,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"9 months, 1 week","timestamp":1760033498,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1796650071/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Recover Binary Search Tree","memory":"60.7 MB","code":"/**\n * Definition for a binary tree node.\n * struct TreeNode {\n *     int val;\n *     TreeNode *left;\n *     TreeNode *right;\n *     TreeNode() : val(0), left(nullptr), right(nullptr) {}\n *     TreeNode(int x) : val(x), left(nullptr), right(nullptr) {}\n *     TreeNode(int x, TreeNode *left, TreeNode *right) : val(x), left(left), right(right) {}\n * };\n */\nclass Solution {\npublic:\n    TreeNode*prev = nullptr;\n    TreeNode* first_violation = nullptr;\n    TreeNode* second_violation = nullptr;\n    \n    void solve(TreeNode* root)\n    {\n        if(!root) return;\n\n        solve(root->left);\n\n        if(prev && root->val < prev->val)\n        {\n            if(first_violation == nullptr) first_violation = prev;\n            second_violation = root;\n        }\n        prev = root;\n\n        solve(root->right);\n    }\n\n    void recoverTree(TreeNode* root) {\n        solve(root);\n        swap(first_violation->val , second_violation->val);\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"recover-binary-search-tree","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":908}
